name: card-fieldset
title: Card fieldset
description: Card number, expiry and security code as one connected group with spacing, brand detection and a Luhn check, ready to swap for hosted fields.
docs: A frame for the card form, with no payment in it: nothing is stored, logged or sent, and the inputs have no name, so a surrounding form cannot post them. onChange(value, state) gets { number, expiry, code, name } (number is digits only, expiry is 'MM/YY') and { brand, valid }; control it with value or start it with defaultValue. The number is spaced as you type (4-4-4-4, or 4-6-5 for American Express), the network is named in words beside the field, and the length of the code follows it. The Luhn check, a month from 01 to 12 and 'not in the past' run when a field is left, each message tied to its input with aria-describedby and aria-invalid; a message that shows follows the typing, and showErrors shows every message now, empty fields too. The focus moves on to the expiry and the code only when the part before is complete, and Backspace in an empty field goes back. The fields carry the cc-number, cc-exp, cc-csc and cc-name tokens and numeric keyboards. renderField(part, field) mounts your processor's hosted field for 'number', 'expiry' or 'code' in the same frame (return undefined to keep the built-in one); a part you replace does not count towards valid. showName adds the optional name, now fixes the moment the expiry is checked against, disabled dims the whole frame and turns the fields off (a hosted field is handed disabled to pass on), and labels holds the fixed words.
